title: PACK AND BOOT SHAPES
why: His order of 2026-10-15: every cosmetic should change the silhouette, not only a colour. Four new packs on the BACKPACK rack that change the outline of your back: a Bedroll Pack with a rolled blanket across the top, a Radio Pack with a box and a tall antenna, a Fuel Can Pack with a red can strapped on the outside, and a Frame Pack, taller and wider with side pouches. Two new boots: Shin Guards, steel plates over the lower leg, and Tall Gaiters, laced leather up to the knee. They start from the canvas pack and the black boots, so a colour scheme paints them, and they carry the scheme accent. The pack and boot tiles now show the piece on the figure. Both go across the two-window link. Cosmetic only.
now: Four new pack shapes and two boot shapes in FASHION: bedroll, radio, fuel can, frame pack, shin guards, tall gaiters.
